subject: Virtual Tour coming soon!
author: ZombieTron
body:
... possibly! I will need to get Xandu to sort it out, but once we have received the poster I will try to do an online exhibit of all of our Burnout/Criterion Games stuff.

I wonder who the other bidder was? I'm glad it wasn't you Umo as I would have felt bad if I prevented you from winning!!

subject: What are your opening times?
author: umopapisdnpuaq
body:
I'm glad I didn't outbid you now. I am very happy to know it's gone to such a good home. I wasn't the other bidder but I did consider putting in a bid.

The only thing that stopped me was the fact I would rather have had something more integral to the production of the game and maybe something else will come up for auction.

Imagine some early design proofs for the SPECIAL series. Or a copy of the network server code and an xbox devkit with a few late builds and a database of GOD commands.

Maybe one day eh? 😉
